												IB MTS 2025 : Scheme of Examination

												
													
														
															
															Tier
															
															
															Description of Exam
															
															
															Marks
															
															
															Total Marks

															Tier-I
															Online Exam of Objective type MCQs, divided into 4 parts containing 100 questions of 1 mark each on:
															a) General Awareness
															b) Quantitative Aptitude
															c) Numerical/Analytical/Logical Ability & Reasoning
															d) English Language
															 
															100
															1 Hour
														
														
															a) General Awareness
															40
														
														
															b) Quantitative Aptitude
															20

															20
														
														
															d) English Language
															20
														
														
															Negative marking of ¼ mark for each wrong answer.
														
														
															Tier-II
															Descriptive Test on English Language and Comprehension
															(Basics of English Language, its vocabulary, correct grammar, sentence structure, synonyms, antonyms and its correct usage, etc., to test comprehension and paragraph writing in 150 words)
															50
															50
															1 Hour
														
													
												

												Important Notes:

												 

												
													
													The cut-off marks (out of 100) in Tier-I exam would be UR-30, OBC-28, SC/ST-25 & EWS-30 (all Ex-servicemen & PwBD would be treated in their own category viz., UR/OBC/SC/ST/EWS).
													
													
													On the basis of their performance & normalization of marks in Tier-I exam, qualified candidates would be shortlisted for Tier-II @ 10 times the number of vacancies.
													
													
													The Tier-II exam is qualifying in nature. The qualifying marks in Tier-II is 20 out of 50.
													
													
													Final merit list would be prepared on the basis of performance in Tier-I exam, provided the candidate is qualified in Tier-II exam.

															Online Exam of Objective type MCQs, divided into 4 parts containing 100 questions of 1 mark each on:
															a) General Awareness
															b) Quantitative Aptitude
															c) Numerical/Analytical/Logical Ability & Reasoning
															d) English Language

															Tier-I
															Online Exam of Objective type MCQs, divided into 4 parts containing 100 questions of 1 mark each on:
															a) General Awareness
															b) Quantitative Aptitude
															c) Numerical/Analytical/Logical Ability & Reasoning
															d) English Language

															40

															20

															Tier-II
															Descriptive Test on English Language and Comprehension

															50

													The cut-off marks (out of 100) in Tier-I exam would be UR-30, OBC-28, SC/ST-25 & EWS-30 (all Ex-servicemen & PwBD would be treated in their own category viz., UR/OBC/SC/ST/EWS).

													The Tier-II exam is qualifying in nature. The qualifying marks in Tier-II is 20 out of 50.

															Tier-I
															Online Exam of Objective type MCQs, divided into 4 parts containing 100 questions of 1 mark each on:
															a) General Awareness
															b) Quantitative Aptitude
															c) Numerical/Analytical/Logical Ability & Reasoning
															d) English Language
															 
															100
															1 Hour

															40
														
														
															b) Quantitative Aptitude
															20

															20
														
														
															d) English Language
															20
														
														
															Negative marking of ¼ mark for each wrong answer.
														
														
															Tier-II
															Descriptive Test on English Language and Comprehension
															(Basics of English Language, its vocabulary, correct grammar, sentence structure, synonyms, antonyms and its correct usage, etc., to test comprehension and paragraph writing in 150 words)
															50
															50
															1 Hour
														
													
												

												Important Notes:

												 

												
													
													The cut-off marks (out of 100) in Tier-I exam would be UR-30, OBC-28, SC/ST-25 & EWS-30 (all Ex-servicemen & PwBD would be treated in their own category viz., UR/OBC/SC/ST/EWS).
													
													
													On the basis of their performance & normalization of marks in Tier-I exam, qualified candidates would be shortlisted for Tier-II @ 10 times the number of vacancies.
													
													
													The Tier-II exam is qualifying in nature. The qualifying marks in Tier-II is 20 out of 50.
													
													
													Final merit list would be prepared on the basis of performance in Tier-I exam, provided the candidate is qualified in Tier-II exam.

															Tier-I
															Online Exam of Objective type MCQs, divided into 4 parts containing 100 questions of 1 mark each on:
															a) General Awareness
															b) Quantitative Aptitude
															c) Numerical/Analytical/Logical Ability & Reasoning
															d) English Language

															1 Hour

															20

															Descriptive Test on English Language and Comprehension
															(Basics of English Language, its vocabulary, correct grammar, sentence structure, synonyms, antonyms and its correct usage, etc., to test comprehension and paragraph writing in 150 words)

												Important Notes:

												 

												
													
													The cut-off marks (out of 100) in Tier-I exam would be UR-30, OBC-28, SC/ST-25 & EWS-30 (all Ex-servicemen & PwBD would be treated in their own category viz., UR/OBC/SC/ST/EWS).

													The Tier-II exam is qualifying in nature. The qualifying marks in Tier-II is 20 out of 50.
													
													
													Final merit list would be prepared on the basis of performance in Tier-I exam, provided the candidate is qualified in Tier-II exam.

															Tier-I
															Online Exam of Objective type MCQs, divided into 4 parts containing 100 questions of 1 mark each on:
															a) General Awareness
															b) Quantitative Aptitude
															c) Numerical/Analytical/Logical Ability & Reasoning
															d) English Language

															1 Hour

															20

															20

															Descriptive Test on English Language and Comprehension
															(Basics of English Language, its vocabulary, correct grammar, sentence structure, synonyms, antonyms and its correct usage, etc., to test comprehension and paragraph writing in 150 words)

															50

												Important Notes:

												 

												
													
													The cut-off marks (out of 100) in Tier-I exam would be UR-30, OBC-28, SC/ST-25 & EWS-30 (all Ex-servicemen & PwBD would be treated in their own category viz., UR/OBC/SC/ST/EWS).

															Tier-I
															Online Exam of Objective type MCQs, divided into 4 parts containing 100 questions of 1 mark each on:
															a) General Awareness
															b) Quantitative Aptitude
															c) Numerical/Analytical/Logical Ability & Reasoning
															d) English Language
															 
															100
															1 Hour

															40
														
														
															b) Quantitative Aptitude
															20
														
														
															c) Numerical/Analytical/Logical Ability & Reasoning
															20
														
														
															d) English Language
															20
														
														
															Negative marking of ¼ mark for each wrong answer.
														
														
															Tier-II
															Descriptive Test on English Language and Comprehension
															(Basics of English Language, its vocabulary, correct grammar, sentence structure, synonyms, antonyms and its correct usage, etc., to test comprehension and paragraph writing in 150 words)
															50
															50
															1 Hour
														
													
												

												Important Notes:

												 

												
													
													The cut-off marks (out of 100) in Tier-I exam would be UR-30, OBC-28, SC/ST-25 & EWS-30 (all Ex-servicemen & PwBD would be treated in their own category viz., UR/OBC/SC/ST/EWS).
													
													
													On the basis of their performance & normalization of marks in Tier-I exam, qualified candidates would be shortlisted for Tier-II @ 10 times the number of vacancies.
													
													
													The Tier-II exam is qualifying in nature. The qualifying marks in Tier-II is 20 out of 50.
													
													
													Final merit list would be prepared on the basis of performance in Tier-I exam, provided the candidate is qualified in Tier-II exam.

															Tier-I
															Online Exam of Objective type MCQs, divided into 4 parts containing 100 questions of 1 mark each on:
															a) General Awareness
															b) Quantitative Aptitude
															c) Numerical/Analytical/Logical Ability & Reasoning
															d) English Language
															 
															100
															1 Hour

															40
														
														
															b) Quantitative Aptitude
															20

															20

															20

															Tier-II
															Descriptive Test on English Language and Comprehension
															(Basics of English Language, its vocabulary, correct grammar, sentence structure, synonyms, antonyms and its correct usage, etc., to test comprehension and paragraph writing in 150 words)

															50

												Important Notes:

												 

												
													
													The cut-off marks (out of 100) in Tier-I exam would be UR-30, OBC-28, SC/ST-25 & EWS-30 (all Ex-servicemen & PwBD would be treated in their own category viz., UR/OBC/SC/ST/EWS).

															c) Numerical/Analytical/Logical Ability & Reasoning
															d) English Language
